summary: Enhance your skills with our Fraud and Internal Controls Training Course. Learn to identify risks and implement effective controls to protect your organization.
lede: Fraud and financial audit training helps audit, finance, compliance and operations professionals strengthen controls and address fraud risks in business processes. Learners practice assessing and prioritizing fraud risks, designing preventive and detective controls across financial cycles, and using transaction analysis, monitoring dashboards and investigation procedures to identify anomalies and respond to concerns.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for safeguarding assets, ensuring financial accuracy, and maintaining ethical standards within their organizations.
modules: Internal Control Foundations and COSO® Framework
Fraud Psychology and Behavioral Red Flags
Forensic Data Analytics and Detection Tools
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of business processes and basic financial principles. Experience in internal audit, accounting, risk management, or general management is recommended. No prior forensic accounting experience is required, but familiarity with the COSO® Framework is beneficial.
